mapper.sql: u.id AS id, u.id AS user_id, u.username AS username, NULL AS real_name, u.phone AS phone, u.email AS email, NULL AS agent_code, al.name AS level, u.status AS status, u.created_at AS created_at, u.updated_at AS updated_at
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_agent_level ual ON ual.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN agent_levels al ON al.id = ual.level_id WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.role = 'agent' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_agent_level(user_id, level_id, assigned_at, effective_date) VALUES(#{userId}, #{levelId}, NOW(), CURDATE()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE level_id = VALUES(level_id), assigned_at = NOW(), effective_date = CURDATE()
